products.title: Metric Female Multiseal Hose Fitting
products.descriptionShort: Metric Female Multiseal — 60° cone seat, metal-to-metal (no O-ring), 27 sizes, -04 to -20.
products.descriptionLong:
The Metric Female Multiseal Hose Fitting is a hydraulic hose fitting with 60° cone seat, metal-to-metal (no O-ring).

The supplier calls this series "multiseal" and does not define the term. Measured against its own catalogue it is unambiguous: at every shared thread and bore the seat depth sits within about a millimetre of the 60° cone and four to five millimetres away from both the flat seat and the 74° cone. What it does not carry is an O-ring — the 24° multiseal sits beside its O-ring twin in the same book with an identical thread, tube diameter and hex, and no O-ring column at all.

Construction

  • Configuration: straight
  • Thread: M10×1 to M52×2
  • Sealing form: 60° cone seat, metal-to-metal (no O-ring)
  • Gender: female-swivel
  • Material: carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated (316 stainless on request)

Sizes

27 sizes, -04 to -20, threads M10×1 to M52×2. The full size and dimension table is on this page.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching crimp ferrule — the ferrule follows the hose, not the fitting. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch.
products.seoTitle: Metric Female Multiseal Hose Fitting | M10×1–M52×2
products.seoDescription: Metric Female Multiseal Hose Fitting — 27 sizes (-04 to -20), M10×1 to M52×2. Carbon steel or 316 stainless, ex-Dubai.

faqs.question: What does "multiseal" mean here?
faqs.answer: It is the supplier's name for the series, and they do not define it. What we can tell you is what it measures as: at every shared thread and bore the seat is within about a millimetre of the 60° cone in the same range, and four to five millimetres away from both the flat seat and the 74° cone. So order it as a 60° cone fitting. If your port is flat-faced or takes a bonded seal, ask us before you order — we are confirming with the manufacturer whether this seat is cut to take both, and we would rather tell you the answer than guess it.

faqs.question: Does it have an O-ring?
faqs.answer: No. This is the metal-to-metal variant. The catalogue lists a dimensionally identical fitting that does carry an O-ring in the cone — same thread, same hex — and this is not it. Both will start on the same thread, which is what makes them easy to order by mistake.

faqs.question: What is the sealing form?
faqs.answer: 60° cone seat, metal-to-metal (no O-ring). Pair it with the matching counterpart — a mismatched sealing form will seat but will not hold pressure.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 27 sizes, -04 to -20, threads M10×1 to M52×2. Every row in the table on this page is an orderable part number.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The hose grade and bore set the assembly rating, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose. Tell us the grade and bore on the RFQ and we will confirm the figure in writing.

faqs.question: Which ferrule pairs with this fitting?
faqs.answer: The one that matches your hose grade — the skive/no-skive choice follows the hose construction, not the fitting end. Send the hose grade with your enquiry and we will specify the ferrule and the crimp diameter.

faqs.question: Is stainless steel available?
faqs.answer: Yes — 316 stainless on request across the range. Standard supply is carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated. Add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can Indus crimp the assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We crimp, pressure-test and certify assemblies in Dubai and ship UAE-wide. Send the hose grade, bore, both end fittings, overall length and orientation.

faqs.answer: Only the seal. That one carries an O-ring in the cone; this one seals metal to metal. Thread, tube diameter and hex are identical, so both will start on the same port and only one of them is what your joint was designed for. Check which the port expects before ordering.

faqs.question: What is the sealing form?
faqs.answer: 24° cone seat, metal-to-metal (no O-ring). Pair it with the matching counterpart — a mismatched sealing form will seat but will not hold pressure.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 9 sizes, -04 to -12, threads M14×1.5 to M36×2. Every row in the table on this page is an orderable part number.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The hose grade and bore set the assembly rating, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose. Tell us the grade and bore on the RFQ and we will confirm the figure in writing.

faqs.question: Which ferrule pairs with this fitting?
faqs.answer: The one that matches your hose grade — the skive/no-skive choice follows the hose construction, not the fitting end. Send the hose grade with your enquiry and we will specify the ferrule and the crimp diameter.

faqs.question: Is stainless steel available?
faqs.answer: Yes — 316 stainless on request across the range. Standard supply is carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated. Add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can Indus crimp the assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We crimp, pressure-test and certify assemblies in Dubai and ship UAE-wide. Send the hose grade, bore, both end fittings, overall length and orientation.

Sizes

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching crimp ferrule — the ferrule follows the hose, not the fitting. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch.
